function: Learned message splitting into sub-data and per-sub-data power allocation for uplink RSMA of multi-type services to a LEO satellite, minimizing utility loss of information (UoI); pp. 9-10.
system: One LEO satellite at 600 km with Nr=4/8/16 receive antennas; K=3-10 single-antenna UEs (Nt=1); 1 MHz bandwidth; no RIS; carrier frequency not stated; pp. 3-4, 12.
method: MAPPO (multi-agent PPO, actor-critic) deep reinforcement learning, one agent per UE, trained by interaction with the simulated environment; reward combines UoI and a SIC-rate penalty; pp. 9-10.
data_channel: Own simulator: shadowed-Rician fading, free-space plus atmospheric path loss, Bessel antenna gain, Markov-chain status source; no 3GPP model, public dataset or measurement; pp. 3-4, 12.
test_conditions: Training and testing in the same simulated environment; sweeps over SNR 0-20 dB, K, Nr, R, N, Kg; no unseen scenario, transfer or adaptation reported; pp. 11-13.
baselines: Conventional RSMA with fixed 2 sub-data [34], NOMA [24]; in Fig. 11 each also with MAPPO or WMMSE power allocation; no other learned method compared; pp. 11, 13.
metrics: Average UoI, average power consumption and access failure probability (AFP) versus SNR, number of UEs, states, query interval and group size; pp. 11-13.
complexity: Network complexity of MAPPO (actor plus critic) stated as O(K(5Dc+LcDc^2+Lmax+1)+(5KDc+LcDc^2+Dc)); no runtime or FLOPs reported; p. 11.
q1_support: p. 4: "as a widely-used shadowed-Rician (SR) fading channel" - own simulator with its own path loss and antenna gain (Eqs. 3-4); no 3GPP TR 38.811 or 38.901 model, dataset or measurement is named.
q2_support: p. 12: "under different numbers of receive antennas" - sweeps over SNR, Nr, K, R and N inside one simulated setting (Table I); no test of a model trained elsewhere, and no transfer or fine-tuning, is stated.
q3_support: p. 11: "against conventional RSMA (with a fixed number of 2 sub-data per UE) [34] and NOMA [24]" - non-learned baselines exist (also WMMSE, p. 13); no earlier learned method or other DRL algorithm is compared.
q4_support: p. 11: "network complexity of MAPPO in Ag-RSMA scheme is" O(K(5Dc+LcDc^2+Lmax+1)+(5KDc+LcDc^2+Dc)), actor plus critic networks.
q5_support: p. 11: "we present simulation results evaluating" - the paper's own simulations (Table I, p. 12); no code or data link, public dataset or measured data is mentioned.
notes: Borderline on function: the learned MAPPO controls message splitting and transmit power of uplink RSMA to a LEO satellite, scored with the semantic UoI metric; included as area 6 (learned power and resource control of a satellite link). Fig. 11 (p. 13) runs RSMA and NOMA with MAPPO or WMMSE; q3 is 0 because RSMA with 2 fixed sub-data is a variant of the proposed scheme, MAPPO is the proposed learner, and the paper does not describe [24] or [34] as learned. The shadowed-Rician model is the paper's own simulator model, not a 3GPP profile. Table I and Algorithms 1-2 were read as page images.
